title: Web-Token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.10, 4.0.0 before 4.0.7, and 4.1.0 before 4.1.7 contain an…
description: Web-Token jwt-framework and jwt-library versions before 3.4.10, 4.0.0 before 4.0.7, and 4.1.0 before 4.1.7 have an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the PBES2AESKW::unwrapKey() function. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to send a JSON Web Encryption (JWE) token with a PBES2-HS*+A*KW algorithm and a very large p2c iteration count, causing excessive CPU usage due to lengthy PBKDF2 computations.
